narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to educate viewers on the basics of ETF (Exchange Traded Fund) investing. It uses a structured approach, starting with a simple fruit analogy to explain the concept of diversification, then listing the benefits of ETFs (low entry, easy trading), and finally categorizing them for different investor needs. The goal is to demystify financial products for a general audience.
